changes.title: Woodlouse evolution
items: The woodlouse evolves: a pale round baby of five plates, a slate-grey young with pale-edged plates, a ten-plated adult with raised flecked rims, jointed feelers and tail spikes, and the wispy forest's legend: armoured like a fortress, spiked shields, moonstone spires along its spine and dry leaves caught in its plates

changes.title: Ram evolution
items: The ram evolves: a curly white lamb with big ears, a young with its first horn buds, a heavy-horned adult with a full dark curl and a fleece ruff, and the tangly forest's legend: huge bronze horns in a double spiral with thorns along their ridges, brambles and red berries woven through its shaggy fleece

changes.title: Creator alive
items: In the creator she can't keep still: she fixes her hat, twirls, bounces, laughs, looks out of the window, practises a step and looks round the room, and spins to show off each change you make
The fairy lights round her room come on one by one as the forest grows, and flash when it's ready
